Modern Pay Engine (MPE)
https://modernpayengine.com

One integration for every way money moves. For people today, for machines tomorrow.

MPE provides orchestration and control software. MPE never holds funds, and does not store customer identity documents.

MPE is not a bank.

Modern Pay Engine (MPE) is MPE Solutions, Inc, at modernpayengine.com. On this site, MFAM always means MPE's Machine Financial Authority Module.

MFAM is identity and authority for machines. Patent pending, working today.
